reviews.text: I purchased a mini skid loader grapple bucket from these folks . Super good quality. Lower price than other ones!! I ordered it to be shipped right to me and the shipping $ was very reasonable. They were very responsive with my calls and emails .

reviews.text: I recently purchased a root grapple attachment from Mt. View Welding and Fabrication, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. The product is outstanding—well-built and incredibly effective for my needs.
